Ferroptosis induced by various flavonoids in GI cancers − Flavonoids (green orbs) exhibit anti-cancer effects by inducing ferroptosis through multiple molecular pathways

Mechanisms of ferroptosis induced by various flavonoids in GI cancers − Flavonoids (green orbs) exhibit anti-cancer effects by inducing ferroptosis through multiple molecular pathways. The figure illustrates the interaction between flavonoids, key regulators of ferroptosis and other components. (Green arrow – promotion/activation/upregulation of lipid peroxidation; black arrows indicate different progressing molecular pathways; upward green arrows – upregulation; downward red arrow – downregulation; red T ending lines – inhibition). Created with BioRender.com. (For interpretation of the references to colour in this figure legend, the reader is referred to the web version of this article.)
